content.short: Wireshape TCPR is a decentralized global product data curation and registry system.
content.description: Launched in 2023, Wireshape Token Curated Product Registry (TCPR) is a decentralized system that curates product information on the Wireshape Blockchain Network, maintained by the community and incentivized with WWIRE tokens. In TCPR, token holders curate and validate product data, ensuring accuracy and quality. Consumers benefit from free access to high-quality product information, while applicants and voters earn rewards in tokens. The system defines a workflow for product registry, curatorship, updates, and brand verification. Through incentives, transactions, and rewards in WWIRE tokens, TCPR promotes transparency, trust, and fairness in managing product information. It aims to align incentives and ensure data quality for a self-governing, next-generation e-commerce ecosystem.
